bridgeRouteRisk.summary: USDH has one canonical native issuance route on HyperEVM and one peripheral HyperCore HIP-1 linked representation. HyperCore and HyperEVM are parts of the same Hyperliquid blockchain; the linked asset reflects the HyperEVM token through protocol system-address transfers and CoreWriter supply reflection, not an independently issued USDH bridge route. No USDH-specific validator, DVN, peer, escrow, or rate-limit controller was verified.

routes.protocol: Bridge Building USDH native issuer contract
routes.reviewNote: The HyperEVM ERC-20 is the only verified canonical USDH issuance deployment. The verified implementation restricts mint and burn to MINTER_ROLE, requires approved recipients, and enforces totalSupply + amount <= getMaxSupply(); the issuer-native reserve-ledger handler and TokenAuthority are recorded in Mint Authority.

routes.protocol: Hyperliquid HIP-1 HyperCore ↔ HyperEVM linked USDH representation
routes.reviewNote: Hyperliquid spotMeta/tokenDetails identify USDH as token index 360 with token ID 0x54e00a5988577cb0b0c9ab0cb6ef7f4b, isCanonical false, and an EVM link to the HyperEVM contract. The HIP-1 asset is represented through the HyperCore system address 0x2000000000000000000000000000000000000168 and CoreWriter supply reflection from EVM mint/burn; it is not independently issued. This platform linkage is peripheral to the HyperEVM canonical route.
